messages.subject: dplyr Netezza SQL backend - problem with summarise
parts:
Hi:

I am trying to add Netezza database as a sql backend to dplyr.  I am able to get a table object but running into problems with summarise(). 
Following the Flights data sample, I get the following error:
> mydb <- src_nzdb(dbname,host,port,user,password)
> flights <- tbl(mydb,"FLIGHTS")
> x1 <- group_by(flights,YEAR,MONTH,DAY)
> x1

messages.subject: Re: dplyr Netezza SQL backend - problem with summarise
parts:
Hadley, 

Thank you for responding.   I found my "bug" last night.  I must have loaded "plyr" after loading "dplyr" and as a result the code was using plyr::summarise() instead of dplyr::summarise().  After detaching plyr from the memory, the code worked!

Balaji
